description: New paid and free heroes and their reveal start at zero stars. Preserve existing ranks and duplicate/ascension rules; prevent a negative bonus at ordinary zero stars.

edits.name: Paid new hero starts with zero stars
edits.old: br: rar, r: rar, k: 1, race: pickRace(cls, nm)
edits.new: br: rar, r: rar, k: 0, race: pickRace(cls, nm)

edits.name: Paid reveal starts with zero stars
edits.old: r0: cur ? cur.r : rar, k1: 1, r1: rar
edits.new: r0: cur ? cur.r : rar, k1: 0, r1: rar

edits.name: First free recruit starts with zero stars
Free reveal starts with zero stars
Do not penalize ordinary zero-star heroes
edits.old: function tavTier(g) { return g ? g.r * 4 + g.k - 1 : 0; }
edits.new: function tavTier(g) { return g ? Math.max(0, g.r * 4 + g.k - 1) : 0; }
